collection.label: Homer, Odyssey (Florence manuscript)
collection.search_terms: homer odyssey odysseus telemachus penelope athena ithaca epic
collection.description: Homer's Odyssey page by page on the oldest Odyssey manuscript with published images, Florence, Laur. Plut. 32.24 (10th century), with Murray's Greek and English. The codex ends at book 24, line 103; the rest of book 24 is not in it.
